entities.summary: Ottoman, a notable figure in the history of Syria, associated with Mamluk and Ottoman Syria (1516–1831). Preceded by Battle of Marj Dabiq — Ottomans defeat the Mamluks and conquer Syria and Mamluk Syria. Their legacy influenced Construction of the Azm Palace in Damascus — finest Ottoman palace in Syria.
